rule: GitHub evicts the least recently used Actions cache entries once the repository passes its limit (tools/github/actions-cache-policy.json max_cache_size_gb). The repository stays under cap_percent_of_limit of it; each key belongs to the entry with the longest matching key_prefix and stays under its max_mb; a protected entry must exist, because the merge queue rebuilds every dependency without it. scripts/ci/actions_cache_budget.py measure reads the live cache list and fails on any breach.
